text:
The month moved at a steady, manageable pace for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.

Passenger support stayed consistent across the network of skyports, with clear pre-departure guidance reducing avoidable confusion and keeping check-ins orderly. The desk handled a balanced mix of routine bookings and special animal travel requests, and coordination with operations remained smooth. Communication with travelers stayed direct and practical, which helped keep the process moving without delay.

For Halcyon, 64 pets fit in the pet cabin. For Brightwater, Fara Noll handled pets on board. Those assignments supported the wider schedule and gave the desk firm points of contact for planning and handoff. Pet travel forms were reviewed promptly, and staff kept close watch on crate compliance, routing notes, and boarding sequence. The team also tracked a few last-minute changes, then adjusted the worklist without disrupting service.

Traveler support remained a central task. Gabriel Berg and Liam Haddad both received clear guidance on documentation, cabin rules, and the steps for smooth transfer at the skyport. Biscuit was among the pets requiring extra attention, and the desk kept the file current from booking through departure. This steady follow-through limited repeat calls and cut down on avoidable corrections. It also reinforced confidence among passengers traveling with animals, which is the point of the service.

Internal coordination stayed disciplined. The desk matched its records to the daily flight plan, confirmed pet acceptance against space limits, and flagged any missing details early. Staff kept language plain and instructions consistent, which helped passengers prepare without confusion. No major service gaps were recorded, and the month closed with the desk operating at a calm and reliable pace.

Next month, the desk will keep its focus on clean handoffs, timely updates, and prompt review of pet travel requests. The team will continue to support safe, orderly movement for animals and their travelers across the Aurelia Skyways network.
